# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in contributing to a zencq project! Contributions that fit the scope of the repository and are useful to its users are especially welcome.

## Before you start

- Check existing issues and pull requests before starting substantial work.
- For larger changes, open an issue first to discuss the approach and how it fits the scope of the repository.
- Please follow our [code of conduct](https://github.com/zencq/.github/blob/HEAD/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- For security vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](https://github.com/zencq/.github/blob/HEAD/.github/SECURITY.md); please don't report them publicly.

## Making a change

1. Fork the repository and create a branch for your change.
2. Keep changes focused and generally applicable to the users of the repository. Avoid adding behavior that only one specific use needs.
3. Follow the repository's code style and guidelines. Where it has agent instructions in `.github/instructions/`, they are the style guide, and they also apply when you use AI coding agents.
4. Add or update tests and documentation when relevant.
5. Build and run the relevant tests using the repository's solution or project files. Check that the CI checks pass for your changes.
6. Open a pull request describing what changed and why it is useful. Link relevant issues; use a closing reference such as `Closes #123` when the pull request fully resolves an issue.

The `README.md` of the repository lists the supported .NET versions and any other requirements.

## Pull requests

Keep pull requests focused and reasonably sized. Very broad, massive, or unspecific pull requests may be asked to be narrowed or clarified, or may not be accepted. If a change would be easier to review in smaller pieces, please split it into separate pull requests.

Include relevant test results in the pull request description. Required CI checks must pass before a pull request can be merged; if a check fails or cannot be run, explain why.

## Review process

Maintainers may request changes or clarification before merging. Please keep discussion constructive and respond to review feedback. Submitting a contribution does not guarantee that it will be merged.
